name: eggd_treehouse_pipeline
title: eggd_treehouse_pipeline
summary: DNA Nexus app to run Treehouse pipeline 'expression' and 'qc' functionality

whatsNew.v1.0.0: Initial release of the Treehouse expression and QC pipeline on DNAnexus

inputSpec.name: fastq_R1
inputSpec.label: FASTQ R1 file
inputSpec.help: Gzipped FASTQ file for read 1 of the sample. Filename must contain _R1, _R1_001, or _1 before the extension so the Treehouse Makefile can detect it.

inputSpec.name: fastq_R2
inputSpec.label: FASTQ R2 file
inputSpec.help: Gzipped FASTQ file for read 2 of the sample. Filename must contain _R2, _R2_001, or _2 before the extension so the Treehouse Makefile can detect it.

inputSpec.name: references_files
inputSpec.label: Name of reference file array
inputSpec.help: Reference files needed to run Treehouse Pipeline: kallisto_hg38.idx, starIndex_hg38_no_alt.tar.gz, rsem_ref_hg38_no_alt.tar.gz

inputSpec.name: github_repo
inputSpec.label: GitHub repository of Treehouse pipeline as a tar.gz file
inputSpec.help: Tar.gz file of the GitHub repository of Treehouse pipeline

inputSpec.name: docker_packages
inputSpec.label: Docker CE 19.03.15 packages
inputSpec.help: DNA Nexus file for Docker CE 19.03.15 packages for installation

inputSpec.name: docker_images
inputSpec.label: Docker images for rnaseq-cgl-pipeline, umend_qc and all other required tools
inputSpec.help: DNA Nexus file for Docker images for rnaseq-cgl-pipeline, umend_qc and all other required tools

outputSpec.name: expression_output
outputSpec.label: Expression pipeline output files
outputSpec.help: All output files from the Treehouse expression pipeline (outputs/expression/), including the results tar.gz, sorted BAM, and pipeline logs.

outputSpec.name: qc_output
outputSpec.label: QC pipeline output files
outputSpec.help: All output files from the Treehouse bam-umend-qc pipeline (outputs/qc/), including bam_umend_qc.json, bam_umend_qc.tsv, and readDist.txt.
